senses.gloss:
मृ {c6c} A. (but P. in the Perfect,
the two Futures and the
Conditional) (म्रियते, ममार, अमृत, मरिष्यति,
[]
मर्तुं, मृत) To die, perish, decease,
depart from life. --Caus. (मारयति-ते)
To kill, slay. --Desid. (मुमूर्षति)
1
To wish to die.
--2 To be about to
die, be on the point of death.
